limits: Species-level labels only, no genus or juvenile trait transfer. Local net biomass effects are context specific; not net reproductive effects. Only A. valida has local direct reproductive consumption evidence in matched categories, unknowns not assumed neutral.

Maximum reported body dimensions are species traits from Bodega Harbor, not observed size distribution in Carr; partial matched-only community composition metrics, not representative whole assemblage.
Bodega Harbor assay rates are not measured SF Bay rates; numerical partial-trait means are standardized indices only, no realized consumption or cascade.
A. valida and total abundance per shoot not encounter probabilities; field and feeding studies overlap region and possibly samples; not independent meta-analysis.
Flowering fractions are scenarios, not observed site-month shoot density. No transfer to Thalassia animal pollination or direct otter benefit.
Zeros in previous ledger are reported/omitted-category bookkeeping, not true absence. Ratio over zero denominator undefined; no pseudocounts.
